preview.headlineLine2: where to continue, what to focus on, which mode to open.
preview.introParagraph: I'm proposing the home page become a hub that's simple but clear. Reading mode stays pure and minimal, while the dashboard becomes the place for a progress summary across Baca, Faham, Tema, and Hafal.
preview.step1Helper: Jump straight into the mushaf without a full utility toolbar in front of you.
preview.pagesInTodaySession: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} in today's session
preview.openSabakSabqiManzil: Open a Sabak, Sabqi, Manzil session
preview.step2Helper: The daily summary and review queue sit in one place.
preview.jumpAudioOutside: Jump and audio sit outside the mushaf
preview.step3Helper: I imagine it as a popup on desktop and an intermediate page on mobile so reading mode stays pure.
preview.footerNote: Note: the Baca and Hafal cards use real signals that already exist. Faham and Tema are still proposal metrics. Bookmark has been removed from this proposal, and jump/audio have been repositioned as a utility layer.
preview.utilityLayerTitle: Jump and audio don't sit inside the mushaf.
preview.utilityLayerParagraph: I agree these two things should come out of the main surface. On desktop, they can appear as a popup or slide-over. On mobile, I prefer a clear intermediate page so the mushaf view stays clean.
preview.tadabburParagraph: If we want space for tafsir, hadith, and reflection, I think the best word for it is Tadabbur. But I wouldn't place it as a primary card yet. It's better for it to appear after Faham and Tema mode have matured.
preview.readHelperWithActivity: Uses the server snapshot so the reading number stays consistent across devices. Last activity {activity}.
preview.readHelperEmpty: The mushaf stays minimal. The main focus is jumping straight into reading without a bookmark or a utility panel above the page.
preview.pagesIn7Days: {count, plural, one {# page in 7 days} other {# pages in 7 days}}
preview.fahamHelper: I understand this mode as a word-by-word memorization engine: match Arabic words with their Malay meaning, do a recall, then reveal the answer little by little.
preview.temaHelper: Themes should be their own path, not buried under Faham. Track which chunks have been explored by surah.
preview.hifzHelperActive: {todayPages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} active today across Sabak, Sabqi, and Manzil, with {duePages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} already due now.
preview.hifzHelperEmpty: Hafal should stay its own workspace focused on Sabak, Sabqi, and Manzil.
